user.title: Set up V-P2000
user.description:
One group per line, as `name: capcode, capcode`. For example:

`Station A: 1234567, 1234568`
`Dive team: 1234570`

V-P2000 fires the event `v_p2000_alarm` for every new page on one of these capcodes. The data comes from AlarmeringDroid, a free service: keep the interval at 10 seconds or more unless every second counts.
